name: 🎵 Bardic Spell Song: Whispers on the Wire

components.label: Description
value: Selena sings in a hushed, melodic whisper while balancing on a high wire or elevated perch. Her voice carries unnaturally far, threading through the air like a secret on the wind. components.html:
✨ Description:

Selena sings in a hushed, melodic whisper while balancing on a high wire or elevated perch. Her voice carries unnaturally far, threading through the air like a secret on the wind. This spell allows her to send a message of up to 25 words to any creature within range that she can see. The message is delivered in her voice, flavored with her signature southern drawl and circus cadence.

If cast during a performance, the message can be woven into lyrics, allowing her to communicate covertly with allies or charm a target with subtle persuasion.

Silver thread, the wire sings,
Carry my voice on feathered wings.
Hear me now, though far you be,
My words shall dance invisibly.

* - ((a strand of silver thread))
